name: Reveal Sheet
description: Directional accessible sheet with a circular reveal, adjustable bounce, and optional edge shine.
summary: A reusable Radix Dialog sheet that can open from any edge of the viewport. An inward-facing semicircle grows from the midpoint of that edge to reveal the panel, then its free edge pushes outward and springs back.
highlights: Top, right, bottom, and left sheet directions through one side prop
Adjustable entrance and bounce speed through one speed multiplier
Optional grid and independently configurable animated edge shine
Edge-origin semicircular reveal with an elastic free-edge overshoot, powered by GSAP
Radix Dialog semantics, Escape handling, focus management, and portal rendering
Reduced-motion fallback and keyboard-visible close control
Children-first API for composing existing DevClub UI components
anatomy: Radix Dialog Overlay (dimmed, lightly blurred page backdrop)
Radix Dialog Content (directional fixed sheet with circular reveal)
Header (title, optional description, rotating close button)

physics.engine: GSAP clip-path reveal and elastic edge
physics.description: The sheet fills from an inward-facing semicircle centered on its viewport edge. As the fill reaches the far corners, the panel extends slightly past its free edge, then springs back to its resting size.

parameters.label: Reveal origin
parameters.value: Midpoint of the selected viewport edge

parameters.label: Speed multiplier
parameters.value: 1× by default; scales the complete reveal and bounce timeline

parameters.label: Reveal easing
parameters.value: power3.inOut reveal followed by a four-step damped overshoot

parameters.label: Edge overshoot
parameters.value: 3.2% along the sheet opening axis at bounce=1; adjustable from 0 to 2×

parameters.label: Reduced motion
parameters.value: Clip-path reveal and moving border highlight disabled; static highlight remains

accessibility.aria: Radix Dialog provides labelled content, modal semantics, focus management, Escape handling, and portal isolation.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The circular reveal and moving border highlight are skipped when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.

keyboard.description: Focus remains managed inside the open sheet.

recommended: Component showcases, settings panels, editor inspectors, and contextual detail views
Using side=right for desktop inspector layouts and side=bottom for mobile-first actions
Composing existing DevClub UI primitives through children
bestPractices: Keep the sheet content focused on one task or collection
Provide a concise title and description for screen-reader users
Do not place another modal inside the sheet unless the interaction truly requires protected focus

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the sheet is visible.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the sheet opens or closes.

props.name: side
props.description: The viewport edge from which the sheet appears.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback multiplier for the complete opening animation; values above 1 are faster.

props.name: showGrid
props.description: Whether to show the subtle grid texture inside the sheet.

props.name: showShine
props.description: Whether to show the animated highlight tracing the sheet border.

props.name: shineDirection
props.description: Direction of travel for the border highlight.

props.name: shineSpeed
props.description: Playback multiplier for the border highlight.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible sheet title displayed in the header.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting text below the title.

props.name: children
props.description: Sheet content, including existing DevClub UI components.

props.name: className
props.description: Adds classes to the sheet panel.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Whether to render the animated close button.
